reason: Since the installed release (39b2dd1) the schema gained the table cq_drive_periods with its index, and the model gained the drive identity (DriveId) on DriverRecord, DriverStatus and DriverSummary, the types DrivePeriod, DrivePeriodState and DriveEntry, the requests DriverRequest.Periods and DriverRequest.Drives with their replies, and BackupTable.DrivePeriods; earlier in the same span the model gained the phase Await of UsagePhase, the type AwaitedSpan and the optional field await of PhaseSpan with the field truncatedWaits of PhaseReport (a wait of a session on the operator, stored in the body of a cq_usage_spans row and read through it, whose stored rows lack the fields check and await, which the decoder requires to be present, so the SQL adds both as null to every stored span and the updater verifies that nothing else in a span changed), the type RetainedWait, and what tells a governing session that a person settled what it waits on (AwaitedEnd, the branches Watching, Settled and Released of SessionUnitEvent, the field settled of WaitOutcome.Ended) and the per-check usage report, and the field runningSpans of PhaseUsage (a report computed at read time and stored nowhere; a span of the phases Check, Integrate or Combine may now be registered Running and finished once, which changes no stored row and no column of cq_usage_spans). dev/local-update.sql creates the table and the index as server/src/main/resources/db/001-ledgers.sql declares them, gives every stored driver a new drive identity in its body and its summary, adds check and await as null to every stored span, records the state each driver is in as the first period of its drive (the time it stopped, or the time it was last touched), and records that schema's hash; the updater verifies that no other table, no other value of a driver and no other value of a span changed, that each driver has exactly one such period, and that the updated database has the structure the new schema declares. The SQL changes nothing when it is applied again. Project archives are not converted; an archive of the installed release is refused by its schema hash. The model also gained the type TierRecommendation and the optional field recommendation of Content.Task; the generated decoder reads a stored Task without it as a Task with no recommendation (dev/generate patches it), so no stored row, draft or artifact body is rewritten for it. AgentsAction.Resolve gained the list members, which no stored value contains. The generated Pi extension changed earlier in this span, so a project that uses Pi runs cq configure pi --replace after the update.
